shots.description: 橘色虎斑猫走在雨夜住宅街道上
shots.prompt_zh: 一只橘色虎斑猫（参考图：猫定妆图），额头有 M 形条纹，琥珀色眼睛，白色胡须，毛发被雨打湿，低着头在雨夜的住宅区街道上慢慢往前走，路面积水倒映着路灯和窗户的暖光，细雨落下。低机位，镜头在猫前方缓慢后退跟拍。3D 动画电影质感，冷蓝夜色与暖黄窗光对比，柔和体积光，单一画面，镜头连贯。
shots.prompt_en: An orange tabby cat (use cat reference image), fur soaked by rain, walks slowly down a rainy suburban street at night, puddles reflecting streetlights and warm window light, light drizzle. Low-angle camera slowly tracking backward in front of the cat. 3D animated feature film look, cool blue night vs warm yellow window glow, soft volumetric light, single full-frame shot, continuous camera.

shots.description: 同一只猫的脸部大特写
shots.prompt_zh: 同一只橘色虎斑猫的脸部大特写，额头 M 形条纹，琥珀色大眼睛湿润，胡须挂着雨珠，耳朵微微下垂，轻轻眨眼。镜头极慢推近，背景虚化成暖色光斑。3D 动画电影质感，浅景深。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme close-up of the same orange tabby cat's face, big wet amber eyes, raindrops on whiskers, ears slightly lowered, blinks gently. Very slow push-in, background blurred into warm bokeh. 3D animated film look, shallow depth of field.

shots.description: 小女孩隔着雨窗向外看
shots.prompt_zh: 温暖的室内，一个黑色长发扎低马尾、穿淡紫色针织开衫的小女孩（参考图：女孩定妆图）走到窗边，隔着挂满雨痕的玻璃往外看，表情从好奇变成担心。中近景，镜头在窗外，透过玻璃拍。3D 动画电影质感，室内暖光。
shots.prompt_en: In a warm living room, a little girl with long black hair in a low ponytail, wearing a lavender knit cardigan (use girl reference image), walks to the window and looks out through rain-streaked glass, her expression changing from curious to worried. Medium close-up shot from outside through the glass. 3D animated film look, warm interior light.

shots.prompt_zh: 房子的前门打开，暖黄的光洒到门廊上，同一个穿淡紫色开衫的小女孩站在门内，弯下腰轻声招呼；门口的橘色虎斑猫抬头看她，犹豫一下后慢慢走进门。中景，固定机位后轻微推近。3D 动画电影质感。
shots.prompt_en: The front door opens, warm yellow light spills onto the porch. The same girl in the lavender cardigan stands inside, bending down to call softly; the orange tabby cat at the doorway looks up at her, hesitates, then slowly walks inside. Medium shot, static then gentle push-in. 3D animated film look.

shots.prompt_zh: 温馨客厅，同一只橘色虎斑猫蜷缩在白色绒毛毯上，毛已经擦干变得蓬松，舒服地眯眼打盹，尾巴轻轻摆动；背景里穿淡紫色开衫的女孩模糊地走过，落地灯暖光。低机位近景，镜头缓慢横移。3D 动画电影质感，治愈氛围。
shots.prompt_en: Cozy living room, the same orange tabby cat curled up on a fluffy white blanket, fur now dry and fluffy, eyes half-closed dozing contentedly, tail swaying gently; the girl walks by blurred in the background, warm floor-lamp light. Low-angle close shot, slow lateral dolly. 3D animated film look, heartwarming mood.

shots.description: 火星沙丘远景里的一台小机器人
shots.prompt_zh: 火星表面超大远景，橙红色沙丘绵延到地平线，薄雾和尘埃，远处一台很小的白色圆柱形清洁机器人孤零零地停在沙丘间，机身有橙色警示条纹。航拍视角缓慢向前推进。电影级写实，暖橙色调，广角，单一画面。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme wide shot of the Martian surface, orange-red dunes stretching to the horizon, thin haze and dust, a tiny white cylindrical cleaning robot with orange hazard stripes alone among the dunes far away. Aerial camera slowly pushing forward. Cinematic photorealism, warm orange palette, wide angle, single full-frame shot.

shots.prompt_zh: 一台老旧的火星基地清洁机器人（参考图：机器人定妆图），白色圆柱形机身正面印着黑色「CL-01」，底部履带，一只机械臂末端是圆形刷子，头部是单个圆形蓝色摄像头，橙色警示条纹，表面有红色沙尘，停在火星沙地上，轻轻转动头部。低机位正面中景，镜头缓慢推近。电影级写实，侧逆光，漂浮的尘埃。
shots.prompt_en: An old Mars-base cleaning robot (use robot reference image), white cylindrical body with black "CL-01" on the front, tracked base, one arm ending in a round brush, a single round blue camera eye, orange hazard stripes, red dust on the surface, parked on Martian sand, gently turning its head. Low-angle frontal medium shot, slow push-in. Cinematic photorealism, side backlight, floating dust.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一台 CL-01 清洁机器人的圆形蓝色摄像头大特写，镜头光圈缓慢收缩对焦，像在眨眼，背后夕阳逆光勾出轮廓。固定机位，浅景深。电影级写实。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme close-up of the same CL-01 cleaning robot's single round blue camera eye, the aperture slowly contracting to focus like blinking, sunset backlight rimming its silhouette. Static camera, shallow depth of field. Cinematic photorealism.

shots.prompt_zh: 微距特写，红色火星沙地上一株嫩绿的小芽从生锈的金属碎片下钻出来，细沙被风吹动，柔和侧光。固定机位，极浅景深。电影级写实。
shots.prompt_en: Macro close-up, a tiny green sprout pushing out from under a rusty metal fragment on red Martian soil, fine sand blown by wind, soft side light. Static camera, very shallow depth of field. Cinematic photorealism.

shots.prompt_zh: 火星日落后，同一台 CL-01 清洁机器人停在沙丘顶上，缓缓抬起圆形蓝色摄像头望向天空，暗蓝色天幕中一颗明亮的蓝色小星点（地球）慢慢亮起，机器人的镜头里倒映出这个蓝点。中景剪影，镜头缓慢环绕。电影级写实，冷蓝与暖橙渐变的天空。
shots.prompt_en: After sunset on Mars, the same CL-01 cleaning robot on a dune crest slowly raises its round blue camera toward the sky; in the deep blue sky a bright small blue dot (Earth) slowly appears, reflected in the robot's lens. Medium silhouette shot, slow orbit. Cinematic photorealism, sky gradient from warm orange to cool blue.

shots.description: 女店员独自在收银台后
shots.prompt_zh: 凌晨的便利店内景，冷白色日光灯，货架整齐，一个扎低马尾、穿白衬衫和墨绿色店员马甲的年轻女店员（参考图：店员定妆图）独自站在收银台后，疲惫地伸了个懒腰。全景，固定机位。写实电影感，冷青色调，安静氛围，单一画面。
shots.prompt_en: Convenience store interior at 3 a.m., cold white fluorescent lights, neat shelves, a young female clerk with a low ponytail, white shirt and dark green staff vest (use clerk reference image), alone behind the counter, stretching tiredly. Wide shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, cold teal grade, quiet mood, single full frame.

shots.description: 灰衣女人拿着黑伞进店
shots.prompt_zh: 从店内朝门口拍，雨夜，自动玻璃门缓缓打开，一个穿灰色长外套、黑色长发、面色苍白的女人（参考图：神秘顾客定妆图）手里握着一把收起的黑色长柄伞，慢慢走进来，地面湿漉漉反着光。全景，固定机位。写实电影感，冷色调。
shots.prompt_en: Shot from inside toward the entrance, rainy night, the automatic glass doors slide open, a pale woman with long black hair in a long grey coat (use customer reference image), holding a closed black long-handled umbrella, walks in slowly, the wet floor reflecting light. Wide shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, cold tones.

shots.description: 店员看见第三把相同的黑伞
shots.prompt_zh: 同一个女店员站在收银台后，看着柜台上第三把一模一样的黑色雨伞，又抬头看向对面的灰衣女人，表情从礼貌变成不安。过肩近景，镜头缓慢推近女店员的脸。写实电影感，浅景深。
shots.prompt_en: The same clerk behind the counter looks at a third identical black umbrella on the counter, then up at the woman in grey, her expression shifting from polite to uneasy. Over-the-shoulder close shot, slow push-in on the clerk's face. Realistic cinematic, shallow depth of field.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一个灰衣黑发女人的面部特写，她慢慢抬起头，嘴角露出一个僵硬的微笑，眼神直视镜头，背后日光灯轻微闪烁。特写，极慢推近。写实电影感，冷色调，悬疑氛围。
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the same pale woman in grey with long black hair, she slowly lifts her head, a stiff smile forms, staring straight into the lens, fluorescent light flickering slightly behind her. Close-up, very slow push-in. Realistic cinematic, cold grade, suspense mood.

shots.description: 卷帘门外堆满相同的黑伞
shots.prompt_zh: 便利店门外夜景，卷帘门已经拉下，门口的伞架里插满了几十把一模一样的黑色雨伞，旧招牌字迹斑驳，雨水从屋檐滴落。中景，镜头缓慢上摇到招牌。写实电影感，暗调。
shots.prompt_en: Exterior of the convenience store at night, the rolling shutter is down, the umbrella stand by the door is stuffed with dozens of identical black umbrellas, the old sign is weathered, rain dripping from the eaves. Medium shot, slow tilt up to the sign. Realistic cinematic, low-key lighting.

shots.prompt_en: A bamboo forest path at dusk, golden sunset light slanting through dense bamboo stalks, fireflies and light dust floating, the eaves of a wooden tea pavilion faintly visible in the distance. Wide shot, slow push forward. Japanese anime film style, warm orange vs deep green, soft volumetric light, single full frame.

shots.prompt_zh: 一只红狐狸（参考图：狐狸定妆图），白色胸毛和尾尖，披着一件深红色小斗篷，脖子上系着金色铃铛，沿着竹林小径走来，停下回头看向镜头。中全景，镜头在侧前方平行跟拍。日式动画电影风格，逆光勾边。

Medium-wide shot, camera tracking alongside. Japanese anime film style, rim backlight.

shots.prompt_zh: 竹林深处一座小小的木质茶亭，青苔覆盖的石灯笼和竹编门帘，桌上摆着茶壶和茶杯，同一只红狐狸坐在茶亭门口，像守门人一样端坐。全景，镜头缓慢横移。日式动画电影风格，黄昏暖光。
shots.prompt_en: A small wooden tea pavilion deep in the bamboo forest, moss-covered stone lanterns and a bamboo door curtain, a teapot and cups on the table, the same red fox sitting upright at the entrance like a guardian. Wide shot, slow lateral pan. Japanese anime film style, warm dusk light.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一只红狐狸的近景，它张嘴开口说话（口型自然），一只前爪轻轻按在茶壶盖上，茶壶冒出带金色光点的热气。中近景，固定机位后轻微推近。日式动画电影风格。
shots.prompt_en: Close shot of the same red fox speaking (natural mouth movement), one front paw gently resting on the teapot lid, steam with golden sparkles rising from the pot. Medium close-up, static then slight push-in. Japanese anime film style.

shots.description: 狐眼亮起，茶亭灯笼点亮
shots.prompt_zh: 同一只红狐狸的眼睛特写，金色瞳孔慢慢亮起；镜头随即缓慢拉远成远景，整座茶亭的灯笼一盏盏亮起，金色光带环绕茶亭，夜幕降临竹林。一次连续拉远，不跳切。日式动画电影风格，暖金与深蓝对比。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme close-up of the same red fox's eyes, golden irises slowly glowing; the camera then pulls back in one continuous move to a wide shot as the pavilion's lanterns light up one by one, golden ribbons of light circling the pavilion, night falling over the bamboo forest. Japanese anime film style, warm gold vs deep blue.

samples.idea: 外卖小哥送餐路上遇到各种离谱事
samples.rewrite_notes: 改成追鹅的送餐乌龙。不包含橱窗或暴露服装。
samples.negative_prompt_zh: 分屏，三分屏，多画面拼接，画中画，边框，拼贴，服装颜色变化，换装，头盔变化，车辆型号变化，换脸，手部变形，多余手指，肢体扭曲，物体穿模，违反物理，暴露服装，字幕，水印，画面闪烁，突然跳切，低清晰度
samples.negative_prompt_en: split screen, triptych, multi-panel, collage, picture-in-picture, border, uniform color change, outfit change, helmet change, vehicle model change, face swap, deformed hands, extra fingers, distorted limbs, object clipping, physics violation, revealing clothing, subtitles, watermark, flickering, sudden jump cut, low resolution

assets.name: 外卖骑手
assets.prompt_zh: 角色设定图，正面、侧面、背面三视图加两张表情（疲惫、憨笑），同一位 40 多岁亚洲男性外卖骑手，短黑发，银色半盔头盔，深蓝色外卖夹克带银色反光条，黑色手套，深色长裤，棕色斜挎包，写实摄影风格，纯灰色背景，服装完全一致。
assets.prompt_en: character sheet, front / side / back plus two expressions (tired, goofy grin), same Asian male delivery rider in his 40s, short black hair, silver half helmet, dark navy delivery jacket with silver reflective stripes, black gloves, dark trousers, brown crossbody bag, photorealistic, plain grey background, identical outfit.

assets.name: 电动车和外卖箱
assets.prompt_zh: 一辆黑色电动踏板车，后座固定黑色方形外卖箱，箱盖可打开，多角度产品图，写实，纯灰背景。
assets.prompt_en: a black electric scooter with a black square delivery box mounted on the back, openable lid, multi-angle product shots, photorealistic, plain grey background.

assets.name: 雨夜城市街道
assets.prompt_zh: 雨夜城市街道，湿漉漉的柏油路反射霓虹与街灯，路边小店，无人物，写实电影场景图，16:9。
assets.prompt_en: rainy city street at night, wet asphalt reflecting neon and streetlights, small shops on the side, no people, photorealistic cinematic environment, 16:9.

shots.prompt_zh: 雨夜城市街道，一个外卖骑手（参考图：骑手定妆图），戴银色头盔，穿深蓝色带银色反光条的外卖服，骑着黑色电动车后座带黑色外卖箱，从镜头前驶过，尾灯在湿漉漉的路面上拖出红光。中景，镜头在骑手身后跟拍。写实电影感，霓虹夜色，单一画面。
shots.prompt_en: Rainy city street at night, a food delivery rider (use rider reference image) in a silver helmet and a dark navy delivery jacket with silver reflective stripes, riding a black e-scooter with a black delivery box on the back, passes the camera, taillight streaking red on the wet road. Medium shot, camera following behind the rider. Realistic cinematic, neon night, single full frame.

shots.description: 鹅钻进外卖箱叼走餐盒
shots.prompt_zh: 同一个骑手停在红绿灯前，银色头盔，深蓝色反光条外套，黑色电动车和黑色外卖箱不变。一只鹅从路边钻进他的外卖箱，叼走了一份外卖盒，骑手瞪大眼睛回头。中景，固定机位。写实电影感，喜剧节奏，动作清晰。
shots.prompt_en: The same rider stops at a red light; a goose pops out from the roadside into his delivery box and snatches a food box, the rider turns back wide-eyed. Medium shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, comedic timing, clear action.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一个骑手骑着同一辆黑色电动车在小巷里追一只叼着外卖盒的鹅，路边行人纷纷让路。全景，镜头侧面平行跟拍。写实电影感，轻快喜剧氛围。
shots.prompt_en: The same rider chases a goose carrying a food box through a narrow alley on his e-scooter, neighbors stepping aside. Wide shot, side tracking camera. Realistic cinematic, light comedic mood.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一个骑手头盔下的面部特写，银色头盔和深蓝色反光条外套仍在，满头大汗，喘着气，露出憨厚又无奈的笑。特写，固定机位。写实电影感，街灯暖光。
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the same rider's face under the helmet, sweating and panting, giving an honest, helpless grin. Close-up, static camera. Realistic cinematic, warm streetlight.

shots.prompt_zh: 写字楼门口，同一个骑手双手把外卖递给一位穿灰色西装的年轻顾客，顾客打开盒子，里面坐着那只鹅，两人面面相觑。过肩中景，固定机位。写实电影感，喜剧收尾。
shots.prompt_en: At an office building entrance, the same rider hands the order over with both hands; the customer opens the box and the goose is sitting inside, the two stare at each other. Over-the-shoulder medium shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, comedic ending.
